description: Free, before buying anything: a shared test phone number and a 4-digit code (valid 24 hours, 5 calls). Calling the number and keying the code reaches an AI receptionist answering as the business described here, and hear_url plays the same receptionist in a browser. Nothing is booked, sent or charged on a test line; it shows how a real one sounds. Needs a signed-in account (any permissions). For a real line on the business's own number, use set_up_answering_line.

business_name.description: The name the receptionist answers as, e.g. "Alvarez Plumbing".

hours.description: Opening hours in words, e.g. "Mon-Fri 8 AM to 5 PM, closed weekends".

trade.description: The kind of business; it sets what the receptionist knows to ask.

name: try_answering_line
title: Try an answering line free: a test number and code
